programme.desc: 1965. Drama. Directed by Walter Grauman. Stars Suzanne Pleshette, Bradford Dillman & Ben Gazzara. A wealthy, young woman's insatiable desires threaten to destroy her marriage.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.desc: 1956. Musical. Directed by Maurice Elvey. Stars Nat Jackley, Pat Kirkwood & Bonar Colleano. A group of talented entertainers band together to purchase a run-down theatre to put on a show.

programme.title: A Home for Max Miller
programme.desc: A delightful and entertaining film about the on-going search to find a permanent home in Brighton for the mass of Max Miller memorabilia The Max Miller Appreciation Society holds.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Ghost Coach. Directed by Aaron Spelling and starring Don Durant and Mark Goddard. Cully and Ringo stumbles across an old army stagecoach hidden in an abandoned mine with a skeleton inside.

programme.title: The Gilded Cage
programme.desc: 1955. Directed by John Gilling and starring Alex Nicol. Two brothers are embroiled in a racket to smuggle a valuable painting. When a murder is committed they must try and clear their names.

programme.title: The Secret Man
programme.desc: 1958. Thriller. Director: Ronald Kinnoch. Stars Marshall Thompson, John Loder & Henry Oscar. A physicist finds himself drawn into an investigation to track down a spy at his research station.

programme.title: Tons of Trouble
programme.desc: 1956. Comedy. Directed by Leslie S. Hiscott. Stars Richard Hearne & William Hartnell. Mr Pastry names the apartment boilers he maintains 'Mavis and Ethel'. Trouble begins when he faces the sack.

programme.title: Hour of Decision
programme.desc: 1957. Crime. Stars Lionel Jeffries & Hazel Court. Reporter Joe (Jeff Morrow) finds his wife is the prime suspect in a murder investigation.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed at the end of August and beginning of September.

programme.title: Fighting Man of the Plains
programme.desc: 1949. Western. Stars Randolph Scott, Bill Williams & Victor Jory. Jim Dancer, one of Quantrill's Raiders, stages attacks on Kansas on behalf of the fallen Confederacy.

programme.title: Albert R.N.
programme.desc: 1953. Directed by Lewis Gilbert. Starring Jack Warner, Robert Beatty and Anthony Steel. With the help of a life-like dummy, Allied forces are escaping a POW camp. Based on a true story.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Dress Shop. 1964. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Irene Ryan & Donna Douglas. Mr Drysdale buys a Beverly Hills dress store and the Clampetts show up to help 'the poor widow and her starving girls'.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1958. Crime of Honour. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring Russell Napier, Ivan Craig and Jean Lodge. A Thames Estuary dredger drags a man's body from the bed of the river. (S1, E28)

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Bitter Water. 1960. Stars Lorne Greene, Rhys Williams & Don Dubbins. A rancher's son wants to sell their land for mining operations which will spoil an agreement between his father and Ben.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Diamond Expert. 1954. Stars Paul Carpenter, Hugh Latimer & Leslie Linder. John learns that Claude is a diamond expert. He kills him and assumes his identity but ends up trapping himself.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: We have a newly uncovered reel of the great John Alderton and Richard O'Sullivan, teaching us how to be good salesmen, there's brilliant footage of Southend and who remembers Woollies hot peanuts?

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1975. Detective & Mystery Drama. The Fatted Calf. Stars Alfred Burke, Alun Armstrong & Peter Settelen. Marker's search for a young university student brings him face to a group of revolutionaries.

programme.title: A Dandy in Aspic
programme.desc: 1968. Thriller. Directed by Anthony Mann. Stars Mia Farrow, Laurence Harvey, Tom Courtenay. British Intelligence orders its operatives to eliminate a Soviet spy, unaware he's one of their own men.

programme.title: Nor the Moon By Night
programme.desc: 1958. Adventure. Director: Ken Annakin. Stars Michael Craig, Belinda Lee, Patrick McGoohan. After a the loss of her mother, a young women sets out to find her African pen pal.

programme.title: Three Came Home
programme.desc: 1950. True story of a woman imprisoned in several Japanese war camps. She struggles to protect her young son. Stars Claudette Colbert.

programme.title: Thunder Rock
programme.desc: 1942. Supernatural drama starring Michael Redgrave, Barbara Mullen & James Mason. One of The Boulting Brothers' finest, a disillusioned writer becomes a lighthouse keeper living in solitude.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: Rich Man's Son. 1955. Stars Hugh O'Brian, Lee Erickson & Don Haggerty. The son of a railway executive runs away to become a gun toting ranch hand, but Wyatt teaches him some important lessons.

programme.title: The Last Journey (1935)
programme.desc: 1935. Drama. Director: Bernard Vorhaus. Bob (Julien Mitchell) is distraught with his upcoming forced retirement and believes his wife is having an affair. The day arrives for his final journey.

programme.title: The Large Rope

programme.title: D.O.A. (1949)

programme.title: Miss Robin Hood

programme.title: Doctor In Clover

programme.title: Lorna Doone

programme.title: Star Performance: Dante's Inferno

programme.title: Batman

programme.title: Dial 999

programme.title: California Suite
programme.desc: 1978. Comedy. Directed by Herbert Ross. Stars Jane Fonda, Maggie Smith & Michael Caine. The misadventures and struggles of four sets of guests staying at the luxury Beverly Hills Hotel.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline welcomes you back to the cellar and an evening peppered with terror. This week we go back to the 70s and begin with the 1978 cult classic The Eyes of Laura Mars starring Faye Dunaway.

programme.title: The Eyes of Laura Mars
programme.desc: 1978. Horror/Thriller. Director: Irvin Kershner. Stars Faye Dunaway, Tommy Lee Jones & Raul Julia. A fashion photographer develops a disturbing ability to see through the eyes of a serial killer.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: We return to the topic of sight with the next offering - Mansion of the Doomed. Caroline Munro presents the 1976 horror starring Hollywood greats Richard Basehart and Gloria Grahame.

programme.title: Mansion of the Doomed
programme.desc: 1976. Horror. Directed by Michael Pataki. Stars Richard Basehart, Gloria Grahame & Trish Stewart. An insane surgeon attempts to restore his daughter's eyesight after she is blinded in an accident.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Before Caroline locks up for the night, she allows us to take a peek at next week's thrilling films from top directors.

programme.title: Voyage to the Planet of Prehistoric Women

programme.title: The Big Boodle

programme.title: Charlie Chester Don't Take Chances

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies

programme.title: Stagecoach West

programme.title: Master Spy

programme.title: Look At Life Smashing Through

programme.title: The Return of October

programme.title: Batman
